app.name: DETECTA
app.tagline: Read your lab report. Know when to follow up.
app.disclaimer: DETECTA is a screening aid, not a medical diagnosis. It cannot confirm or rule out any disease. Only a qualified doctor can interpret your results.

home.uploadDesc: Take a photo or pick a file
home.emptyBody: Upload your first lab report and get a plain-language summary in minutes.
home.tip: For the clearest reading, capture the whole page in good light — including the reference-range column.
home.doctorBody: Review patient reports and track markers over time. You're signed in as a doctor.

landing.heading: Understand your lab report with confidence
landing.subheading: Upload a photo or PDF of a blood test, tumor-marker panel, or pathology report. DETECTA reads the values, compares them to reference ranges, and helps you know when it's worth talking to a doctor.
landing.step1Body: Take a clear photo or upload a file of your report.
landing.step2Body: Values are extracted automatically, in English or Arabic.
landing.step3Body: Confirm the numbers, then get a plain-language summary.
landing.safetyTitle: This is a screening aid, not a diagnosis
landing.safetyBody: DETECTA can help you spot values worth a second look, but it cannot diagnose anything. Always follow up with a healthcare professional.
landing.trustedBy: Built for patients across the region
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to stay ahead
landing.featuresSubtitle: Thoughtfully designed for clarity, privacy, and peace of mind.
landing.f1Body: Lab reports from any regional lab — printed in either language, or both — are read accurately.
landing.f2Body: No jargon. Every flagged marker comes with a clear, reassuring explanation in your language.
landing.f3Body: See how your markers move across reports with clean, easy-to-read charts.
landing.f4Body: Your reports are encrypted, visible only to you, and yours to export or delete anytime.
landing.f5Body: A clear indicator tells you when a result is worth discussing with a doctor.
landing.f6Body: One tap to find an oncologist or clinic near you when you need one.
landing.securityTitle: Your health data deserves real protection
landing.securitySubtitle: We treat your reports as the sensitive medical records they are.
landing.sec1: Encrypted at rest and in transit
landing.sec2: Strict per-user access — no one sees your data but you
landing.sec3: Full audit logging of every access
landing.sec4: Export everything or delete your account instantly
landing.howTitle: From photo to peace of mind in minutes
landing.t1Body: Finally a health tool that speaks Arabic natively — my parents can actually use it.
landing.t2Body: I uploaded my tumor-marker panel and understood it before my appointment. That calmed me down.
landing.t3Body: The trend charts made it easy to see my values were stable over three tests.
landing.faq1A: No. DETECTA is a screening aid that helps you understand your lab values. It cannot diagnose disease — only a qualified doctor can.
landing.faq2A: Yes. Your reports are encrypted at rest, accessible only to you, and every access is logged. You can export or delete all your data at any time.
landing.faq3Q: Does it really work in Arabic?
landing.faq3A: Fully. The entire interface mirrors to right-to-left, and all explanations are written natively in Arabic — not machine-translated.
landing.faq4A: Photos or PDFs of blood tests, tumor-marker panels, biopsy, and pathology reports.
landing.ctaBody: Create your free account and understand your next lab report with confidence.
landing.teamSubtitle: A small team building tools for earlier awareness and peace of mind.
landing.contactSubtitle: Questions, partnerships, or feedback — we'd love to hear from you.
landing.contactSent: Thanks — your message is ready in your email app.
landing.footerTagline: A screening aid for early awareness. Not a medical diagnosis.
landing.footerRights: For educational and screening purposes only.
